race.description: Trish & Stuart Anderson Memorial Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BRAVE SUMMIT (2) barrelled home late when finishing fourth on debut at Corowa over 900m, and the extra 200m second up should be ideal. She has a good gate, and should go close to taking this out. MISS HARD COPY (1) ended her initial prep with a brave effort for second by a neck at Wagga in April, and she will be even stronger this season. She cruised home to win a recent trial, and won't be a maiden for much longer. NOT GUILTY (5) made a bright debut from the Michael Travers stable fresh up at Gundagai on a heavy track, before a poor run at Wagga last time out on a good surface. That run was too bad to be true, and he is worth another chance. LINDOS (9) resumes from a spell that would have done her the world of good, and from a handy gate, she is worth including in all combinations. COOL AS TED (4) is fresh from a spell, and not out of this at some value.
